title: sanguisorba minor subsp. maroccana
intro: Sanguisorba minor subsp. maroccana, commonly known as Creeping Burnet, is a perennial herb belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae) and native to North Africa and Europe. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Creeping Burnet include astringent, hemostatic, and anti-edematous effects, making it useful in treating minor wounds, burns, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
